summary: Option fields: description (full sentences, don't list values, document conditional requirements and mutual exclusivity last), required (only if true), default (match code, booleans as true/false), choices, type (match argument_spec; no choices for bool, elements for list), elements.
questions: Should I list possible values in an option's description?
How do I document mutually exclusive options?
Where do I document an option's default value?
Do bool options need a choices list?
How do I document a list option's element type?

answer_card.title: Documenting option fields
answer_card.answer_md:
- `description`: full sentences; don't list values (use `choices`); describe conditional requirements; put mutual exclusivity as the **last** sentence.
- `required`: only when `true`.
- `default`: must match the code; don't repeat it in description; write booleans as `true`/`false`.
- `choices`: list of values (omit if empty).
- `type`: must match `argument_spec`; `bool` has no `choices`; `list` needs `elements`.
